description: This file defines functions for generating PowerPoint presentations using the 'pptxgenjs' library. It includes utility functions for handling data URLs, applying transformations, resolving template placeholders, and rendering slides with fixed shapes, images, and text based on a normalized template model and user data. Publicly exposed function 'generatePptx' creates a PPTX blob and filename based on provided template, slide order, and data.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a data URL.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File or string path to a data URL asynchronously.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a URL and converts the response blob to a data URL.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified transformations ('bulletsToLines', 'formatPercent', 'formatCurrency') to a given value.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the presentation title from globalFirst data or defaults to 'presentation'.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes and shortens a string to produce a safe filename.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Resolves a value for a specific step and field from the wizard data.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches for positioning within PPTX slides.

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, placeholderId, value)
methods.description: Adds placeholder text to a slide when actual data is missing.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, placeholderId, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds a placeholder or missing image notice to a slide component.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders fixed shapes or images as defined in the layout for a slide.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function that generates a PPTX presentation Blob and filename from template model, slide order, and wizard data.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
